art_instructions: Render a bright, sunny view of the family house yard: cream-painted wooden siding with natural wood texture, terracotta roof tiles, sage-green shutters, a small front porch, a cobblestone path, garden beds of sunflowers and lavender, and a low picket fence. In the left foreground, Panda (a round-faced panda cub) leans forward with both paws out, gently nudging a bright red ball toward the center, smiling and focused. On the right foreground beside the lavender, Koala (small gray with a leaf-green scarf) stands with feet apart and arms open to receive the ball, looking happy and attentive. In the midground near the path, Dinosaur (pea-green with a pale mint belly) is mid-step with arms reaching toward the ball, grinning; his small red backpack rests on the porch step behind him. On a low fence rail near the center-left, Owl perches at kid eye level wearing a small green scarf, leaning forward with one wing slightly out as if joining the play, amber eyes bright and friendly. Place a leafy shade tree at the right edge of the yard with a smooth stone and a few exposed roots at its base, casting dappled shade on the grass. The red ball is mid-bounce between Panda and Koala with a light motion arc on the grass; all four clearly engage in the same game. Keep proportions small and cozy, with warm colors and soft edges for a calm, playful mood.
